No. P-11/12/Agenda/06/2016-RevenueII Date: .12.2025

To,
The Regional Director (All) / Joint Director I/C,
Regional office/Sub Regional Office
ESI Corporation.

Subject: Extension of Scheme to Promote Registration of
Employers/ Employees (SPREE) – Regarding

Sir/Madam,

Reference is invited to Instructions of even number dated 01.07.2025
whereby the Scheme to Promote Registration of Employers/Employees (SPREE)
was launched, as a one-time drive intended to extend social security beneﬁts to all
eligible persons under the ambit of the ESIC who had, so far, remained outside the
ESI coverage. The Scheme was operational for the period from 1st July, 2025 to
31st December, 2025.

It is informed that the ESIC has received many representations from
Employers, Employer’s Associations, Corporation members and State
Governments requesting extension of the Scheme beyond 31.12.2025. The matter
has been examined, and it is hereby informed that considering the requests and
constrains expressed by the stakeholders the Competent Authority has approved
the extension of the Scheme for a further period of one month from 01.01.2026 to
31.01.2026 with same terms and conditions as mentioned in the instruction dated
01.07.2025.

All employers and employees who have not been able to avail the beneﬁts of
the Scheme so far may be informed to take advantage of this extended opportunity
and ensure that all units and employees coverable under the ESI provisions are
duly registered by availing this one-time benefit.

All necessary assistance may be extended to employers for online
registration of their units and employees. Regional Directors and SRO In-Charges
may continue to conduct public relation activities on the Scheme in their respective
areas during the above period.
Yours faithfully,

(Rakesh Roshan)
Dy. Director (Revenue)

Copy to:-

1. The Secretary Labour/Health dealing the ESI Scheme in the state for kind
information & necessary action.
2. PPS to DG and all Divisional Heads, ESIC , Hqrs
